info.title: Dash Core REST API
info.description: Read-only REST interface to the Dash Core node. The response format can be selected either via a URI extension (`.json`, `.hex`, `.bin`) or via the `Accept` header (`application/json`, `text/plain`, `application/octet-stream`). When no extension is present, the Accept header is used; the default is `application/json`. Some endpoints (chaininfo, mempool) are JSON-only.

headerCount.name: count
headerCount.description: Number of consecutive headers to return (1–2000, default 5).

block.description: Full block with verbose transaction objects.

blockNoTxDetails.description: Block with transaction ids only (no full tx objects).

additionalProperties.description: Per-transaction mempool entry, keyed by txid.

bitmap.description: Bit string where each character corresponds to a queried outpoint (1 = unspent, 0 = spent).

badRequest.description: Malformed request (invalid hash, out-of-range parameter, etc.).

notFound.description: Requested resource was not found on the active chain.
